content.text:
I fixed the bug in `anthrouter/pace.py`. The 53 pace tests pass. My full-suite run hadn't finished when I last checked, so the rest of the suite is untested.

**Cause:** `period_workday_dates` counted the first day of the next month as a workday. `period_end` is exclusive (00:00 on the 1st of the next month), but its date was treated as inclusive. For September 2026, UTC, that added Thursday October 1 and gave 23 workdays instead of 22.

**Fix:** The range now ends at the local date of the instant just before `period_end`. I also updated the docstring to say the end is exclusive. Other timezones still work: the range keeps any local dates the UTC month overlaps.

I didn't add a regression test for September 2026, since you asked for source changes only.
